description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating runtime permissions handling, including camera and contacts permissions, with UI interactions and permission request logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating runtime permission requests for camera and contacts, with UI controls and permission handling logic.

methods.name: showCamera
methods.description: Handles 'Show Camera' button click; checks camera permission and either requests it or shows camera preview.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission, showing rationale via Snackbar if needed.

methods.name: showContacts
methods.description: Handles 'Show Contacts' button click; checks contacts permissions and either requests or displays contacts.

methods.name: requestContactsPermissions
methods.description: Requests contacts permissions, showing rationale via Snackbar if needed.

methods.name: showCameraPreview
methods.description: Displays CameraPreviewFragment if camera permission is granted.

methods.name: showContactDetails
methods.description: Displays ContactsFragment if contacts permissions are granted.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles result of permission requests, updating UI and showing Snackbars based on grant results.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and sets up logging; loads RuntimePermissionsFragment if first creation.

methods.name: onBackClick
methods.description: Handles back button click to pop fragment back stack.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up custom logging chain for on-screen and logcat output.
